research_judgment.rationale:
Phase: interpretation of the completed, sealed Batch1 ranking-only prospective campaign (scenario incumbent_checkpoint_20_new_clock, batch 1). Weights are held at [0.075, 0.15] and the incumbent is retained. Both candidates, m5campaign-b1-r1 and m5campaign-b1-r2, were fully evaluated, so actual validation savings are exactly zero — a measured fact, not a forecast, and no zero-evidence runtime claim is made for anything else.

Local direction (predictor serial_pullback_replan5@1.0.0): 4 resolved intervals, coverage 1.0; 2 correct, 2 incorrect, accuracy among resolved 0.5. Both candidates correctly forecast 'increasing' at end_s 0.21, but both forecast 'decreasing' at end_s 0.31 while the observed change was increasing — a wrong sign. Numerical checks: 4/4 stable and converged; successive differences at 0.00025/0.000125 s are ~1e-16 m and ~1e-14 m/s. These are resolution differences, not a physical-error bound.

Original quantitative errors, scored separately against the ORIGINAL M5 tolerances (position 1e-6 m; vector/speed 1e-4 m/s; residual 1e-5): position error norms 1.54e-4 m (r1) and 1.84e-4 m (r2), ~150–185× the 1e-6 m limit → 0/4 position passes; endpoint speed errors -4.73e-3 and -6.63e-3 m/s and velocity error norms 8.49e-3 and 9.50e-3 m/s exceed 1e-4 m/s → 0/4 speed and 0/4 vector passes. Local numerical convergence passes while original accuracy gates fail.

Full-task outcome: both candidates miss 35 deadlines; terminal_error 0.0162 m (r1) / 0.0093 m (r2); holding_max_error 0.0263 / 0.0251 m, ~2.5× the 0.01 m position limit; holding_max_speed 1.149 / 0.907 m/s, ~45–57× the 0.02 m/s limit; joint_acceptance false for both. Neither is position-feasible, so eligibility correctly abstains for both (0/2 resolved, coverage 0.0).

Ranking: 1 planned pair, 0 resolved pairs (coverage 0); pairwise order verdict unresolved; sealed order null; recorded actual order r2 then r1 (r2 has lower sampled max holding speed and smaller terminal error), but one pair is not a validated order. False rejection of the better/acceptable candidate: false; predicted-safe-observed-violating list empty; local holding false-safe 0 this batch (the cumulative development record retains 1 historical holding false-safe); no false-unsafe reported.

Economics (all receipts so far): forecast pair cost 328.594 s; incremental screening 328.594 s; actual evaluations avoided 0; actual validation savings 0 s; counterfactual net savings versus ONE rejected complete evaluation = -328.594 s (negative). required_research_s 0; final research receipted false. One rejected evaluation would have been worth ~692–710 s of instrumented backtracking, but abstention and unresolved order produced no rejection, so the batch is a net cost.

Continuation test: both evaluations complete (true), local numerical passes (true), no local or full-history false-safe (true, no_false_safe true) — satisfied. Resolved correct ranking (false), positive counterfactual net saving (false), accepted research continuation (false) — not satisfied. Batch2 preconditions therefore fail, readiness must start STOP, batch2 is not authorized, and it would end STOP by rule.

Diagnostic usefulness: the local predictor is a usable experimental offline diagnostic for numerical convergence and coarse horizon direction, but on this pair it is not useful screening, carries no eligibility or safety authority, and supplies no quantitative full-task accuracy; complete evaluation remains necessary for the primary objective.

Remaining original M5 failures (unchanged, no threshold relaxed): position/terminal accuracy, speed and vector accuracy, late-interval direction sign, resolved ranking and repeatability, and real-time operation.

Recommendation only (not executed, no tuning): on one registered reset-clock episode at the incumbent checkpoint, hold inputs fixed and test whether the late-interval direction sign error is governed by the held-input extrapolation window by comparing a single backend step against the identical sealed local interval; falsified if the sign error persists unchanged with zero held steps.

screening.qualification: No validated savings, confidence bound or generalization from one pair.

rules.abstention: Incomplete/nonfinite/infeasible history, position violation, or speed gap <=1e-4: abstain. Resolved history rank is a testable forecast, not a proven safe rejection.
rules.constraint_handling: Position or terminal failure makes eligibility unresolved; forecast speed <=.02 is predicted-safe, otherwise predicted-violating. Always evaluate both candidates.
rules.local_direction: Compare predicted change to projected initial speed, observed change to observed initial speed. Absolute change <=1e-4 is neutral; predicted change within numerical uncertainty of +/-1e-4 is indeterminate.
rules.original_gates: Accurate local numerics, useful prospective full-task discrimination/order, broader repeatability and real-time operation remain required. No threshold is relaxed.
rules.primary_objective: Lowest sampled maximum holding speed, conditional on predicted terminal and holding position feasibility.
rules.screening_usefulness: Universal abstention fails useful screening; report pairwise order errors, resolved coverage, accuracy, false rejection and false-safe counts.

factual_notes: Local errors are indexed by TIME, not candidate: BOTH candidates have position/vector/speed errors .000153927/.008491293/-.004733323 at .20-.21, and .000184246/.009501082/-.006631540 at .30-.31. Four candidate checkpoints but only two distinct state/input/time cases: not four independent successes or failures.

Both forecast complete histories are numerically identical. Predicted holding/terminal position .039132747 exceeds .01, so the frozen position gate abstains; raw predicted speed difference is zero as well. Actual sampled speed order is .15 then .075, gap .241738958, but BOTH violate the frozen position-feasibility condition, so do not claim an eligible winner.

No candidate is rejected by this sealed decision. The avoided cost is exactly zero. Use all actual forecast and required research receipts so far, plus this correction when receipted. Instrumented evaluation costs may not be used as an inflated saving comparator.

The first native tool submission was rejected before execution due to an engineering reservation/packet defect. Exact model-authored fields were recovered through the actual native tool in the same grant, without a second provider call. This semantic correction is separate and charged.

A zero-held-step comparison cannot falsify a nonzero-interval speed-direction error. Replace that recommendation with one bounded, coherent investigation and explicit pass/fail criterion based on saved evidence; specify untouched fresh evidence needed after any new method version. Do not execute it.

The original documented milestone requires accurate local prediction, useful prospective full-task discrimination, broader repeatability and real-time feasibility. Do not turn a finished ranking-only experiment into a passed ranking capability or M5 closure.
